Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of Lenovo LOQ 15 (15ARP9) Ryzen 5 RTX 3050?

The Lenovo LOQ 15 (15ARP9) Ryzen 5 RTX 3050 features a 95W TGP (with MUX switch + Advanced Optimus) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

Lenovo LOQ 15 (15ARP9) Ryzen 5 RTX 3050 scores 8.7/10 for software engineering. Its AMD Ryzen 5 7235HS (4 Cores, 8 Threads, up to 4.2 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
